a4440a43bc5ca717993b.text: Listening definitely is not as easy as it looks. As you recall in the previous

e1ba65241e96ddfac67d.text: tasks you have done, you needed to listen to songs again to figure out the meaning in some parts of the song or you might have listened to it before but only now did you realize how insightful it is.

8bb6dc6b983084697750.text: While others find it so “easy” to listen, it is actually a mental work. And this

b2373a575779b6809f40.text: needs to be done with much focus especially if there is no video to watch along with the sound.

3c73741a40f0e34bc806.text: How about audio with a sound? Does it make any difference? The next task

f93a8dd8be6eb75d53c0.text: is about listening with a video.
